purpose: Pre-flight smoke for SAEA-E22-ESB-SHORTFORM-ALIGNMENT-V1 on four rows chosen before any contact to bracket the roster (longest, shortest, median, p90). Three reads, in order of importance: (1) does a manifest declaring asr-wer-esb-whisper + asr-wer-esb + cost seal and score through core.scoring_batch on live outputs -- these two scorers have never run on a sealed bundle; (2) does -c 32768 -np 8 with the resident bf16 mmproj fit this card; (3) a wall-time reading for the flight's projection. The smoke's own WER numbers are on four rows and enter no verdict.

primary.source: NVIDIA NeMo AutoModel, 'Fine-Tune Qwen3-Omni for ASR'
primary.protocol: Whisper EnglishTextNormalizer both sides, greedy, N = 2741 utterances
primary.note: the ONLY same-model published number across this study's three carriers

cross_read.system: Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct on the Open ASR Leaderboard English subset
cross_read.note: two vendor reports of the SAME frozen model that disagree by 2.5 points

paper_row.floor_vintage_note: the first five are the 2026-09-04 leaderboard revision; medium.en / small.en / base.en / tiny.en are the 2026-06-13 vintage, before the normalizer and hardware change

fine_tuned_context_only.note: a fine-tuned number, reported as context only and never as a target

E22-ESB-SMOKE-4.selection: deterministic and pre-registered: the longest utterance (the window-fit and VRAM worst case), the shortest, the median and the p90 by duration

cells.serving_geometry: -c 32768 -np 8, 4096 tokens per slot -- identical to the flight
cells.factor: none; this is the flight's own protocol on four rows

shared_protocol.audio_path: raw audio, bf16 mmproj resident on the GPU, no feature cache directory
shared_protocol.obs: none -- an ESB utterance IS the request; there is no windowing here
shared_protocol.harness: core.flight.FlightRuntime with the shared rails zero-supply direct arm and the OpenJiuwen executor, entered through scripts/flights/run_e22_esb_cell.py -- the same harness, entry-point family and adapter-binding pattern every Audio2Tool direct cell flew
shared_protocol.instruction: Transcribe the speech verbatim exactly as spoken. Never insert, repeat, or add any word you do not clearly hear in the audio. Output only the transcript text.
shared_protocol.instruction_provenance: byte-identical to the instruction SAEA-E21-FULL44-DIRECT-BASELINE-V2 sent, itself byte-identical to the sealed 2026-08-14 fixed-batch-zero-locked-buf90 fragment

evaluation.paper_facing_aggregation: corpus: total S+D+I over total reference words
evaluation.merge_compounds_note: the Open ASR Leaderboard applies merge_compounds=True and we do not; that works against us
metrics: corpus WER under the Whisper EnglishTextNormalizer (paper-facing)
mean of per-utterance WER under the same normalizer
corpus and mean WER under the frozen saea-scoring-v1 normalizer
substitutions / deletions / insertions and reference words
mandatory_slices: the per-call table for all six ESB test calls, corpus WER under both normalizers
natural-mixture (corpus) and equal-call weightings side by side
the utterance-duration decomposition: WER by duration decile, and the 74 utterances longer than 20 s reported separately
the three utterances whose end boundary was clamped to the decoded parent, named
the Earnings-21 full-44 corpus number (8.200) beside this one, with the segmentation, corpus and metric differences named rather than compared silently

execution_plan_basis.planned_model_calls: 4 rows x 1 contact plus generous headroom; the registered ceiling is 50
execution_plan_basis.planned_speech_audio_seconds: 56.760187 s for one pass, rounded to 100; the registered ceiling is 200
execution_plan_basis.planned_gpu_hours: 0.5, essentially all of it model load; the registered ceiling is 1.0

decision.go_no_go: The flight launches only if all three reads are affirmative: both ESB scorers return per-sample rows on the sealed manifest through core.scoring_batch, the geometry serves without an out-of-memory or CUDA fault, and the projected flight time is at or under the 2.0-hour registered ceiling.
decision.claim_surface: none; a smoke's numbers enter no verdict

owner_decision_2026_09_04: Owner decision 2026-09-04 (evening): the six ESB test calls 4432298, 4450488, 4470290, 4479741, 4483338, 4485244, all in the study's Earnings-22 confirmatory split, may be read ONCE for this direct-baseline calibration; they are re-designated calibration-exposed afterwards; 109 confirmatory calls remain for final reporting. No mechanism arm, no knob tuned, no other confirmatory call read.
